name: Campfire
note: Campfire: Remove the small floating orange ember crescents around the flame. Paint the stones of the ring a slightly cooler blue-grey, with a warm orange glow on the faces turned toward the fire, and add a soft orange rim of firelight on the kettle's side facing the flames. Keep the fire, the logs, the stone ring, the kettle, the cabin, the pines, the ground, the pebbles, the grass tufts and the view.
